I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I said thanks and noted they'll be on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile.

They didn't ask for anything, so I didn't take any action. I checked my own calendar for tomorrow and it's empty. That calendar only shows meetings I'm part of, so Hollis may still have meetings I can't see. In the reply, I offered to block their calendar or let someone know if they want.
